exposure: education about physical exercise during pregnancy
achieving weight gain during pregnancy as recommended by IOM guidelines
cohort: The study included 239 postpartum women registered with a primary health care centre in Izmir, Turkey, who were 12-18 months postpartum.
finding: 76.2% of women experienced weight retention, which was significantly correlated with chronic illness, physical exercise education during pregnancy, skipping meals, pre-pregnancy weight and BMI, weight gained during pregnancy, adherence to IOM weight gain guidelines, and physical activity score.
